laws.rule: National Museum of Suez: Private souvenir photography is permitted without flash in the published page. Commercial photography/video needs competent-authority permission; tripods/monopods only for permitted commercial use. Do not touch exhibits/showcases. Food and drinks are excluded from galleries except small water bottles. Bags/luggage larger than 40 by 40 cm are excluded from galleries and directed to the cloakroom. Follow posted instructions; this is the museum's visitor policy, not a governorate-wide photography or luggage rule.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Within National Museum of Suez, follow staff/signs, do not touch exhibits, and keep calls/other noise quiet. Appropriate attire is requested where stated; no specific head-covering or clothing-length rule is invented.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Private souvenir photography is permitted without flash in the published page. Commercial photography/video needs competent-authority permission; tripods/monopods only for permitted commercial use. The page asks visitors to refrain from photographing other visitors or staff because of personal rights; this is not rewritten as a universal criminal prohibition.
